title: HR and Operations Specialist
description: Synthetic people-operations role: coordinate onboarding and offboarding, maintain accurate employee records in an HRIS, partner with payroll and benefits teams, and improve repeatable employee-service workflows. Handle sensitive records carefully and route policy questions for human review. Expected experience: at least 2 years in HR or people operations.
screening_criteria: Coordinate documented onboarding and offboarding steps.
Maintain accurate employee records and changes in an HRIS.
Coordinate payroll or benefits changes with the responsible team.
At least 2 years of relevant HR or people operations experience.

questions.text: Describe an onboarding or offboarding workflow you owned and how you checked every handoff.
How did you verify HRIS changes and coordinate a payroll or benefits update?
Which HR operations responsibilities did you personally handle, for how long, and what process did you document?

requirements.description: Coordinate documented onboarding and offboarding steps.
Maintain accurate employee records and changes in an HRIS.
Coordinate payroll or benefits changes with the responsible team.
At least 2 years of relevant HR or people operations experience.
Document and improve repeatable HR operations workflows.
Documented HR operations training or equivalent relevant practical experience.
